affectedCopies: ExternalChannelProjection is a compact current binding over canonical DPF source versions and customer-owned external resources; source content, remote content bodies, and credentials are not copied into it.
OutboundPublication remains the immutable publication-event receipt and IntegrationImportStagedRecord remains read/import staging. Neither authority moves into the new binding.
The optional credentialId is audit provenance only. Stable identity uses IntegrationCredential.integrationId copied as connectionId, so credential-secret rotation cannot fork the binding.
Metadata accepts at most 24 bounded scalar fields and rejects credential, authorization, content, body, HTML, payload, raw, and secret-like keys before persistence.

migration.name: 20260822044500_add_external_channel_projection
migration.backfill: Additive expand-only migration creates three enums and one empty table. No existing row is read or changed. Rollback disables projection writers/readers while retaining rows as operational identity and drift evidence; a later governed cleanup may remove retired bindings only after external publication receipts and source lifecycle dependencies are reconciled.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: The binding is retained while current, drifted, ambiguous, or deliberately detached because it prevents duplicate remote creation and explains authority history. Disconnect uses the canonical RecordLifecycle retirement fields rather than deleting it. Removal follows the owning source/integration lifecycle only after publication receipts and unresolved ambiguity are reconciled; there is no routine age-based purge.
